clock_policy: Stock boost, no frequency normalization or overclock. Primary/repeat long-shape qualification sampled SM1860–1935MHz and memory6800MHz. Public comparison clocks vary (including a 4096-square timing-regime transition); that range does not apply to all CSV rows.

sampling.comparison: Alternating AB/BA paired samples for D256/FI, CUDA Events around graph replay. Primary/repeat rows are separate native D256 qualification batches; not same-window FI pairs.

scopes.native: Each backend native O/LSE, possibly different log base/layout.
scopes.canonical: FlashInfer GPU FP32 ln2 conversion and contiguous [B,H,Q] LSE included; D256 already returns natural LSE.

FlashInfer_version: 0.7.0 source build, package metadata unknown; source and loaded binary independently verified
input_recipe: CPU Generator seed = seed_argument + q*131 + kv*17; sequential FP32 randn Q/K/V, multiply0.7 then cast FP16.
reference: Comparison benchmark: CPU FP64 QK/softmax/PV on rows0,Q//2,Q-1, all heads; not full long-output FP64.
limitations: 4096-square native comparison exhibits a common timing-regime transition; all samples retained, not used as stable-throughput headline.
